## Reason and changes

Explain the problem, final behavior and affected paths.
Link the issue when one exists and compare its acceptance criteria with the delivered evidence.

## Validation

List actual checks and their results.
Identify reused evidence and explain why the inputs and tools are unchanged.
Record failures, unsupported checks and NOTRUN checks explicitly.
For documentation changes, report source comparison, relative links, template frontmatter, rendering and whitespace checks.

## Limits and review

State compatibility and host validation limits.
Confirm that shared evidence contains no API keys, authenticated URLs, private paths or personal data.
Request independent review of the complete posted change.
